description: Canonical-run matrix v0.1 for the SOM-TOMAS Fortran reference. Each run is a configuration of `box.exe` covering a corner of the gas-phase chemistry coverage space (time scale, OH dose, VOC magnitude, temperature). Used by `scripts/generate_goldens.py` to produce committed reference outputs and by the mechanism-drift CI guard to detect upstream Fortran changes. Matrix design is open to revision when master plan Q5 is answered.

shared_params.comment: Constants across the matrix. The varying axes live in `runs[].params` overrides.

runs.summary: 10-min, OH=1.5e6, GENVOC=0.05 ppm, T=298 K. Identical to the som-jax S1.10 fixture; smoke test for the matrix.
1-hour run at baseline OH and GENVOC. First-generation cascade fully populated; second-generation visible.
4-hour run at baseline OH and GENVOC. Matches `runme.py` default; deeper cascade populated.
24-hour run at baseline OH and GENVOC. Stress test for integrator stability and float32 noise accumulation in DIFUN's RKZ*C*C products. Longest run in the matrix.
4-hour run with OH = 5e5 molec/cm3 (1/3x baseline). Slower oxidation; tests rate-constant scaling and per-step convergence at low rates.
4-hour run with OH = 5e6 molec/cm3 (~3.3x baseline). Faster oxidation; tests stiff-regime convergence under aggressive rates.
4-hour run with GENVOC = 0.005 ppm (1/10x baseline). Tests behaviour near integrator atol; small absolute concentrations stress floor handling.
4-hour run with GENVOC = 0.5 ppm (10x baseline). Tests linearity of rate equations across two orders of magnitude in initial concentration.
4-hour run at T = 273 K. Exercises the temperature dependence of Arrhenius-type rate constants in the SAPRC mechanism (kBL20 etc.).
4-hour run at T = 323 K. Companion to the cold run; rate constants ~3-5x faster at the upper end of typical chamber temperatures.
